brief:
Nassar Nassar said officials submitted a complaint against the Israeli occupation government's coordinator and customs authority to halt what he characterized as a monopoly on supplying goods to Gaza, the Maan Wire reported.

The complaint targets restrictions on merchandise imports into the enclave. Nassar, speaking on behalf of Gaza authorities, did not specify what goods face supply limitations or the precise nature of the alleged monopoly arrangement.
title: Gaza officials file complaint against Israeli coordinator over goods monopoly
